job: Point to recent posts or releases as dated rows, a grid with media, or one large entry beside a list.
purpose: list: dated ruled rows of date, title, summary and tag. grid: media, title and date. featured: one large entry beside a short list. The whole item is the link. For the changelog page itself fd-doc-changelog stays the component.
useWhen: A few recent posts or releases on a landing page, linking to the full list.

avoidWhen.when: A feed of activity in the app.

variants.useWhen: Releases and posts where the date matters.
One post that leads, and a few more.

parts.role: Its title; the link covers the item.
Its frame: an image or the signature texture.
